##### Project general facts

GEMZ is a distinctive residential development, recognized for its striking pyramid-shaped architecture that sets it apart as a future landmark. Located in a prime area with convenient access to key transport links and major malls, the project combines bold design with urban accessibility, creating a unique and well-connected living environment.

The development offers a selection of spacious luxury apartments designed with a contemporary approach and enhanced by a wide range of amenities. Its strategic location ensures easy connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road, making daily commuting seamless while maintaining proximity to lifestyle and retail destinations, supporting a comfortable and dynamic city lifestyle.

Interiors are crafted to reflect bespoke luxury living, featuring high-quality finishes and thoughtfully designed spaces with panoramic city views. Bedrooms are spacious and elegantly styled, while select residences include private pools on balconies, adding an exclusive touch to the living experience. Kitchens come equipped, and the apartments are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
